The Thunderbirds were led by fourth-year head coach [[Todd Simon (basketball)|Todd Simon]] and played their home games at the [[America First Event Center]] in [[Cedar City, Utah]] as members of the [[Big Sky Conference]]. ==Previous season== The [[2018–19 Southern Utah Thunderbirds men's basketball team|Thunderbirds]] finished the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2018–19 season]] 17–17 overall, 9–11 in Big Sky play, finishing in 7th place. In the [[2019 Big Sky Conference men's basketball tournament|Big Sky tournament]], they defeated [[2018–19 Idaho State Bengals men's basketball team|Idaho State]] in the first round,{{Cite news |last=Lester |first=Bryson |date=March 13, 2019 |title=Thunderbirds Advance Past Idaho State, Await Northern Colorado upset No. 2 seeded [[2018–19 Northern Colorado Bears men's basketball team|Northern Colorado]] in the quarterfinals,{{Cite news |last=Lester |first=Bryson |date=March 14, 2019 |title=T-Birds Advance
